{{Short description|Chinese chemist and academic (born 1957)}}
{{family name hatnote|[[Wan (surname)|Wan]]|lang=Chinese}}
'''Wan Lijun''' ({{lang-zh|万立骏}}, born July 1957) is a Chinese chemist, specializing in [[electrochemistry]] and [[surface science]]. He is an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] and a former president of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]].

==Career==
Wan graduated with a B.S. in engineering from [[Dalian University of Technology]] in 1982 and received his PhD degree at [[Tohoku University]] in 1996.<ref name="ICCAS">{{cite web |title=Prof. Li-Jun Wan |url=http://spm.iccas.ac.cn/wanlijun/People/wljys/ |publisher=ICCAS |accessdate=19 July 2019}}</ref> He has been a professor at Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICCAS) since 1999, and was the director of ICCAS from 2004 to 2013. Afterwards, he directed the Beijing National Laboratory for Molecular Sciences and the Key Laboratory of Molecular Nanostructure and Nanotechnology, CAS.<ref>{{cite news |title=WAN Lijun Named as the new President of USTC |url=https://en.ustc.edu.cn/highlight/201503/t20150327_213296.html |accessdate=19 July 2019 |publisher=USTC News Center |date=27 March 2015}}</ref> From 2015 to 2017, Wan was the president of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]].

Wan improved the stability and resolution of [[electrochemical scanning tunneling microscope]] (ECTSM) devices, and resolved a number of related problems, such as the STM imaging mechanisms of various types of chiral molecules. He also designed a series of high-performance electrode materials based on micro/nano composite structures.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Zhang |first1=Qiaoling |title=新当选院士万立骏：几十年磨一剑终会开花结果 |url=http://scitech.people.com.cn/GB/10525386.html |accessdate=19 July 2019 |agency=《科学时报》 |publisher=people.com.cn |date=7 December 2009}}</ref>

Wan was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2009. He is the president of the [[All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese]] since 2017.<ref>{{cite news |title=万立骏当选中国侨联主席 |url=http://www.xinhuanet.com//politics/2017-06/09/c_1121118693.htm |accessdate=19 July 2019 |agency=China News Service |publisher=Xinhuanet}}</ref><ref name="a056">{{cite web | title=中国侨联九届五次全委会议在京闭幕 万立骏当选为中国侨联主席 | website=Sina | date=2017-06-09 | url=https://news.sina.com.cn/c/2017-06-09/doc-ifyfzaaq5840684.shtml | language=zh | access-date=2025-06-12}}</ref>

During the [[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party|20th National Congress of the Communist Party]], Wan was elected as a member of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party|20th Central Committee]].

==Awards==
*[[HLHL]] Science and Technology Achievement Award (2014)
*Chemistry Award of [[TWAS]] (2009)
*2nd-Class Natural Science Award of China (2007)<ref name="ICCAS"/>
